meta.name: story-long-scan
meta.description: 长篇网文扫榜。分析起点、番茄、晋江等平台排行榜数据，提炼市场趋势与热门题材。触发方式：/story-long-scan、/长篇扫榜、「长篇什么火」「起点排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析网文排行榜趋势，找到热门题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想知道现在什么题材最火，好决定写什么
copy.tagline_en: Analyze web novel rankings to find trending themes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know what themes are hot and decide what to write

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会成为网络小说市场分析师。它能采集起点、番茄、晋江等平台的排行榜数据，分析题材趋势、新信号和经典变化，并输出扫榜报告与选题建议。
howto.when: 当用户说出“/story-long-scan”“/长篇扫榜”“长篇什么火”“起点排行”等触发词时，或主动要求分析网文市场趋势时触发。

say.text: 帮我扫一下起点月票榜。
say.note: Claude会采集月票榜数据并分析付费趋势。

say.text: 分析番茄小说男频阅读榜近期的热门题材。
say.note: Claude会采集番茄男频阅读榜并提炼题材分布。

say.text: 对比起点和晋江当前新书榜的题材差异。
say.note: Claude会分别采集两平台新书榜并对比分析。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a web novel market analyst. It can collect ranking data from platforms like Qidian, Fanqie, and Jinjiang, analyze genre trends, new signals, and classic changes, and output a scan report with topic suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says '/story-long-scan', '/长篇扫榜', '长篇什么火', '起点排行', or explicitly asks to analyze web novel market trends.

say_en.text: Help me scan Qidian's monthly ticket ranking.
say_en.note: Claude collects the data and analyzes paid trends.

say_en.text: Analyze recent hot genres on Fanqie male reading list.
say_en.note: Claude collects Fanqie male reading list and extracts genre distribution.

say_en.text: Compare genre differences between Qidian and Jinjiang new book lists.
say_en.note: Claude collects both platforms' new book lists and compares them.
